title: Emrys and the Cellar
author: Juniper Nystrom
blurb: Beatrix Yarrow, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
